key_insight: Under conventional training, capsule networks showed greater adversarial robustness than the tested CNNs and vision transformer across five image datasets.
clinical_relevance: Capsule networks may help improve medical imaging model reliability under adversarial perturbations, but clinical safety and effectiveness remain unestablished.
method: Compared two capsule networks, ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and MedViT.
Evaluated five adversarial attack approaches and performed PGD adversarial fine-tuning.
Analyzed latent representations and Grad-CAM maps to explore model stability.
evidence_signal: Testing covered four medical imaging datasets and MNIST; the abstract reports more stable capsule-network representations and attention maps under adversarial perturbations.
watch_item: The supplied abstract is incomplete and provides no numerical effect sizes or post-fine-tuning results, limiting assessment of the robustness advantage.
paper_title: Adversarial Robustness of Capsule Networks for Medical Image Classification
